name: agent-smith
description: Agent Smith Reloaded v56 — updatable AppImage: the Linux AppImage ships with a gh-releases-zsync update channel baked into its header (plus the matching .AppImage.zsync delta file), so users can get incremental in-place updates from GitHub Releases instead of re-downloading the whole ~290MB image. Carries forward v55.9.2 explicit context control (APPLY button + no 32K snap-back). v56.0.1 adds a typed custom-context field next to the Auto-tune toggle: type ANY ctx value and press APPLY to reload LM Studio at exactly that window. v56.1.0 adds multi-language Piper TTS: a VOICE LANGUAGE dropdown (EN/DE/FR/ES/IT/PL/RU, male medium-quality voices) with on-demand voice download from HuggingFace, plus no-cache headers on the built-in web server so in-place updates never serve stale renderer scripts. v56.2.0 adds an in-app APP UPDATE section: CHECK FOR UPDATES queries the GitHub Releases API for 6Morpheus6/Agent_Smith-Reloaded, and when a newer release exists it downloads the matching AppImage or .deb (with live progress), verifies its SHA-256 against the published asset digest, stages it in userData, and — on the AppImage install — swaps the new image into place (backing up the old one) and relaunches; .deb installs hand off to the system package manager. v56.3.0 hardens the native-binary doctor (scripts/check-native.js): it now probes sharp's libvips-backed image binding — a transitive dependency of @xenova/transformers used by memory embeddings — and re-runs its install script when the prebuilt binary or vendored libvips is missing, so copied/interrupted installs self-heal before start/build instead of dying with 'sharp module missing' at first use. v56.4.0 adds Ollama as a first-class local backend: a PROVIDER dropdown in the CONNECT section switches between LM Studio (OpenAI-compatible /v1) and Ollama (/api/chat, native NDJSON streaming + tool calls), each with its own server URL field; model lists, connection status, chat/agent streaming, and context handling all follow the selected provider, and the choice persists across restarts. v56.5.0 makes ⏏ UNLOAD ALL free BOTH backends: it now also stops resident Ollama models (GET /api/ps + the documented empty-messages keep_alive:0 /api/chat unload) alongside LM Studio's management API, embedding models (all-minilm) are protected from every unload and swap on both sides, picking a new Ollama model from the dropdown immediately stops the previously loaded one, and the launcher's Ollama pre-load is now a one-shot command so no attached CLI client can keep the model resident after Agent Smith is stopped. The same release then closes two more gaps: the Ollama chat model is now freed as soon as Agent Smith exits (the page sends keep_alive:0 on the way out, and the generation lock is a finite 8-minute lease renewed by a heartbeat while the app runs instead of living forever), and the app auto-unloads the OTHER provider's model whenever the PROVIDER dropdown or a model pick makes a backend active — only one chat model is ever resident, embeddings included on both sides. The Ollama lease is now self-correcting end to end: chat requests carry a FINITE 8-minute keep_alive instead of -1 (a session killed mid-run can no longer pin a model forever), a heartbeat re-arms every resident chat model every 4 minutes while the app is open — so the model stays loaded for the WHOLE session through long thinking, slow tool steps and however long the user takes to reply, exactly until the app exits or the model changes (renewals carry the chat's own num_ctx/temperature options, so they never re-init the runner — a question after idle answers directly instead of first emptying VRAM) — closing the page frees it immediately (keep_alive:0) and any session that dies simply stops renewing, so Ollama itself frees the model ≤8 min later; resident models are also re-armed at run end and on boot; and an Ollama context-window overflow (HTTP 400 exceed_context_size_error) now trims the oldest conversation turns and retries instead of returning the same error on every attempt — ending in an actionable message (raise the Context Window slider; Ollama applies num_ctx per request, no reload needed — or clear the chat). The release also bounds what Ollama ever receives: every chat/agent run sends only the system prompt plus the LAST 20 messages of the conversation (the UI keeps the entire history visible and persisted), with the current run's own exchange layered on top — and if even that window overflows num_ctx, the trim-and-retry guard still applies unchanged.
